quotes.author: Peter Gardenfors
quotes.text: The philosophically most important problem seems to be the frame problem.
quotes.full: Turning now to artificial intelligence, the philosophically most important problem seems to be **the frame problem**. In general, this problem can be defined as the problem of finding a (basically epistemic) model that permits changing and complex information about the world to be represented in an adequate and efficient way. A solution to the frame problem would be a way of describing the form of the world that would enable us to translate efficiently our knowledge and beliefs about the world into a computer program. The simple belief sets are badly suited for describing actions that may be performed in such worlds and the changes of the world the actions bring about.
